text:
A student writes three statements about potassium nitrate, KNO3.
1
The relative formula mass of KNO3 is 101.
2
Potassium nitrate contains the three essential elements for plant growth.
3
Potassium nitrate could be used as a fertiliser.
Which statements are correct?
A
1 and 2 only
B
1 and 3 only
C
2 and 3 only
D
1, 2 and 3
subject: Chemistry

content.html: A student writes three statements about potassium nitrate, KNO<sub>3</sub>.
